sentences.text: In short: FRUKTKONGEN AS is an established micro company in "detaljhandel med bredt vareutvalg med hovedvekt på nærings- og nytelsesmidler" based in Porsgrunn, profitable in 2025 and with no open NAV job ads under its org number.
FRUKTKONGEN AS is registered in the industry "Detaljhandel med bredt vareutvalg med hovedvekt på nærings- og nytelsesmidler"; its registered activity is "Butikkdrift med dagligvarer.".
FRUKTKONGEN AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 2016-03-02, registered in Porsgrunn.
It has 7 registered employees, reported revenue of NOK 17.53M for 2025 and an operating result of NOK 670,379 (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of 3.8% and a moderate equity ratio of 36% of total assets.

Revenue fell 5.8% from 2024 to 2025 (NOK 18.62M to NOK 17.53M); it was NOK 19.38M in 2023. The annual result was a profit in each of the 3 filed years read (2023: NOK 919,500, 2024: NOK 985,399, 2025: NOK 512,001).
FRUKTKONGEN AS is led by board chair Ali Mohammad Sakhizadah.
It has a board of 2. The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2026-01-28 (within the past year).
